dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concavity (falcate), with a spline curve showing a sharp inward recession starting approximately 25% below the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex is characterized by a rounded shape classification with a medium pixel radius; lacks acute tapering.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin follows a steep convex contour, rising at an angle of approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The vertical height from the dorsal ridge to the apex is approximately 1.1 times the width of the fin's base at the point of vertical inflection.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Numerous small, white punctate marks (speckles) are distributed across the lateral surface of the fin. The trailing edge appears irregular near the base, though this may be influenced by image cropping.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-to-light gradient pigmentation, with the distal half of the fin being dark charcoal and the proximal base showing lighter, mottled grey tones.
